text:
anya: Quick heads-up — publishing the new on-prem data classification & labeling guidance for Private/VPC installs. This changes required bootstrap configs and default telemetry behavior. Please review and loop in CS/SEs. https://go.redwood.example/onprem-classify :loudspeaker:
kevin: is this mandatory or advisory for customers?
sarah: Mandatory for all NEW installs after 2026-05-15. Existing customers get a 90-day migration window and an opt-in migration script.
anya: Right. New installs must include the classification mapping at bootstrap. Existing installs can accept the policy change via the contract UI to trigger the migration tool.
compliance: Note: any classification flagged as high/regulated requires a signed attestation entry. Audit trail retention = 3 years searchable.
tj: Are agent image changes needed for KMS metadata handling?
eng-release-bot: deploy scheduled: private-agent v2.9.0 -> canaries start 2026-04-20 03:00 UTC. Changelog: https://go.redwood.example/release/2.9.0
maria: Ops note: BYOK-HSM customers will need a tiny init snippet. Example in doc:
```
redwood-agent configure --kms-provider hsm --label-policy /etc/rw/labels.yaml
systemctl restart redwood-agent
```
kevin: who will handle customer comms—CS vs Growth?
anya: CS + Solutions will do direct customer outreach; Growth will publish blog + KB. Owners assigned in the doc.
solutions: I'll prepare a migration FAQ and a short on-call runbook. Drafting now.
support: please add YAML examples for HIPAA/PCI/GDPR templates. I'll follow up with sample tickets.
compliance: added HIPAA/PCI/GDPR templates to doc. Also: telemetry default is OFF for high classification; low/med may opt into aggregate telemetry only.
ops: can we validate label files before bootstrap with one command?
anya: added validator: `redwood-validate-labels ./labels.yaml` (nonzero exit on failure). Also added CI hooks for Dedicated rollout scripts.
sarah: timeline recap: announcement today, canaries 2026-04-20, GA 2026-05-15, grace period end 2026-08-13. Readiness checklist in doc — please review.
kevin: tagging relevant folks: @support @solutions @compliance @eng-runtime :thumbsup:
anya: If no blockers I'll close this thread and spin up a narrower channel for onboarding coordination. Feedback welcome in doc or here.
